notes.trinkets: As a Protection Paladin or any tank in general your trinket slots can be a powerful tool to solve an issue defensively. In many scenarios your class toolkit (Defensive cooldowns) will cover these needs entirely and you can lean towards more offensive trinkets which will be ranked below. In the scenarios where you do need that additional defensive layer there will be a "Defensive" tier which details trinkets of value for these purposes.
